title: Interaction: Cinderheart × water / frost
answer: Cinderheart × water / frost: Water, ice, or snow consumes flame persistence and converts the impact into a 55%-damage no-ignition pressure cloud whose movement still respects consent, anchors, wards, shields, time locks, and body collision. Signature: Pale or frost-blue steam rune, cloud bloom, gust spokes, extinguish hiss, and interaction clash.
